Sudan Army Drone Strike Kills 35 in Darfur Court

The Sudanese army conducted a drone strike on a traditional court in Garra al Zawaya, a village in North Darfur, on Sunday. The attack, which occurred while civilians were gathered for local court hearings, killed 35 people and wounded several others, according to a rights group called Emergency Lawyers. The village is reportedly held by the Rapid Support Forces. This incident is part of the ongoing war between the Sudanese army chief al-Burhan and RSF commander Dagalo, which has resulted in tens of thousands of deaths.
